newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Handelsbanken cut at CSFB.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Handelsbanken cut at CSFB.

text.p: Svenska Handelsbanken was cut to "sell" from "buy" at CS First Boston, a research note from analyst Robert Grant at the brokerage said on Tuesday.
Grant said the move came after Handelsbanken reached his target price and reflected a negative assessment of the company's Stadshypotek acquisition.
"In our view, the acquisition may destroy Skr6 billion in value if worst case assumptions are made on the outlook for mortgage volumes and cross-selling opportunities," Grant said.

"Earnings estimates, revised to reflect the acquisiton, point to an overvaluation of at least ten percent." For 1996 he expects earnings per share of 18.6 krone rising to 23.0 krone for the year after.
The stock was down 1.0 krone at 188.5 by 1210 GMT.
